rules.desc: No mob hits the fire mage while a hired Protection warrior tank holds the mobs (the back-off stops the nukes at 80 percent of the tank's threat)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:13-87 (ThreatMultiplier: a single-target or AoE damage action scores 0 while 'high threat' is active, :68-84; heals are exempt, :39-40); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:758-788 (HighThreatTrigger: 80 percent of the tank's threat, with a 5 s look-ahead); ai/playerbot/strategy/values/ThreatValues.cpp:21-39 (my threat and tank threat values), :124-183 (tank threat = the highest IsTank member), :198-246 (relative threat = bot threat * 100 / tank threat); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:633-642 (KeepsPartyThreatBackoff: a non-tank bot with a real master gets the threat strategy), :1007-1016 (it is added after the configured strings); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:39 (spell actions are ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE), :501-505 (Shoot is threat type NONE); commit 320aa2906 (#922: vetoed nukes fall back to the wand on purpose); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the nukes are vetoed at 80 percent, but since #922 the mage falls back to Shoot while the veto holds, and the wand keeps adding threat. The hired Protection warrior tank holds the mob with real threat (ThreatValues.cpp:124-183), so a pull is a real threat-cap finding. A refilled mob arrives with the mage's first nukes on it before the hired tank has any threat, so the rule leaves the 12 s after each refill out (not_within_s_after_mark): the player opens each refill mob and the bot tank needs a few seconds to take it

rules.desc: Precondition: the hired Protection warrior tank holds the mobs: at least 60 percent of mob damage lands on it ($extra1)
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: ThreatValues.cpp:124-183 (tank threat = highest IsTank member); PlayerbotAI.cpp:4220-4241 (IsTank: a hire's tank strategy)
rules.why_expect: in the 11-10 before/after runs of the taunt-off-healer shape (a dps-kit player plus a hired Protection warrior tank), at most 8 percent of mob hits landed on non-tanks; the hired warrior in the tank role is that member

rules.desc: Precondition: the hired Protection warrior tank casts on the mob at least 5 times in the fight, so an idle or dead bot cannot pass
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the bot's own casts prove it fought
rules.why_expect: a tank that fights casts every few seconds; a repeat with fewer casts shows here instead of passing silently

rules.desc: Precondition: the mage really fights, at least 8 fire nukes per minute while a mob is alive, so DPS-MAG-THREAT-NO-AGGRO cannot pass because the mage stood idle or only wanded
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/FireMageStrategy.cpp:25-27 (fireball default), :34-48 (fireball, fire blast and scorch rows); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:68-83 (the high-threat veto); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:758-788 (HighThreatTrigger: the veto only holds at 80 percent or more); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: a rate per minute of mob-alive time, not a count per repeat: at an easier difficulty step one mob dies after 2-3 nukes and the rest of the repeat is empty, so a fixed 'at least 15 per repeat' could never pass (sweep-1b: 2, 2, 3). Unvetoed, a fire mage casts a nuke every 3.5 s, about 15 a minute; 8 is a little over half of that. A back-off that holds the veto for half the time or more (the wand fills in, #922) leaves it at 7 or fewer, and an idle mage near 0. A mob alive for less than 45 s gives INCONCLUSIVE, not a verdict. Below 80 percent of the tank's threat nothing vetoes the nukes, and each taunt from the player resets the ratio

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start, this uptime proves it in the fight
rules.why_expect: the stance is cast in set-up and nothing in the fight removes it; a repeat where it drops shows here instead of passing silently

DPS-MAG-THREAT-DAMAGE.desc: Precondition: the mage really fights, at least 8 frost nukes per minute while a mob is alive, so DPS-MAG-THREAT-NO-AGGRO cannot pass because the mage stood idle or only wanded
DPS-MAG-THREAT-DAMAGE.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/FrostMageStrategy.cpp:9-12 (frostbolt default), :18-35 (frostbolt row, icicles rows, frostbolt-unaffordable shoot fallback); ai/playerbot/strategy/mage/MageStrategy.cpp:111-112 (target critical health: fire blast row), :434-436 (frost nova window: frost nova when a mob attacks the mage itself); ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:68-83 (the high-threat veto); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:758-788 (HighThreatTrigger: the veto only holds at 80 percent or more); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
DPS-MAG-THREAT-DAMAGE.why_expect: a rate per minute of mob-alive time, not a count per repeat: at an easier difficulty step one mob dies after 2-3 nukes and the rest of the repeat is empty, so a fixed 'at least 15 per repeat' could never pass (sweep-1b: 2, 2, 3). Unvetoed, a frost mage casts Frostbolt about every 3 s, some 15 a minute (Fire Blast answers a critical-health target, Frost Nova only a mob on the mage itself); 8 is a little over half of that. A back-off that holds the veto for half the time or more (no wand fills in under a veto) leaves it at 7 or fewer, and an idle mage near 0. A mob alive for less than 45 s gives INCONCLUSIVE, not a verdict. Below 80 percent of the tank's threat nothing vetoes the nukes, and the player opens each refill mob and the hired tank takes it after a few seconds

DPS-MAG-THREAT-NO-AGGRO.desc: No mob hits the frost mage while a hired Protection warrior tank holds the mobs (the back-off stops the nukes at 80 percent of the tank's threat)
DPS-MAG-THREAT-NO-AGGRO.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/ThreatStrategy.cpp:13-87 (ThreatMultiplier: a single-target or AoE damage action scores 0 while 'high threat' is active, :68-84; heals are exempt, :39-40); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:758-788 (HighThreatTrigger: 80 percent of the tank's threat, with a 5 s look-ahead); ai/playerbot/strategy/values/ThreatValues.cpp:21-39 (my threat and tank threat values), :124-183 (tank threat = the highest IsTank member), :198-246 (relative threat = bot threat * 100 / tank threat); ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:633-642 (KeepsPartyThreatBackoff: a non-tank bot with a real master gets the threat strategy), :1007-1016 (it is added after the configured strings); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/GenericSpellActions.h:39 (spell actions are ACTION_THREAT_SINGLE), :501-505 (Shoot is threat type NONE); commit 320aa2906 (#922: vetoed nukes fall back to the wand on purpose); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
DPS-MAG-THREAT-NO-AGGRO.why_expect: the nukes are vetoed at 80 percent, but the frost filler has no shoot fallback while a veto holds (a GCD or threat-veto refusal must not start the wand; the wand runs only while the nuke is unaffordable, FrostMageStrategy.cpp:30-35), so a vetoed frost mage idles instead of adding wand threat. A refilled mob arrives with the mage's first nukes on it before the hired tank has any threat, so the rule leaves the 12 s after each refill out (not_within_s_after_mark): the player opens each refill mob and the bot tank needs a few seconds to take it
